title: The Black Bat
sentences: Ty and Dad went to the grass to play with a bat and ball.
Ty had a red bat and a black bat.
The red bat had a big crack.
The black bat had no crack.
Dad did not let Ty hit with the red bat.
Dad gave the ball a toss.
Ty hit the ball with the black bat.
The black bat did not crack.
The ball went into the grass.

comprehensionQuestion.question: Why did Ty get the black bat?
answers: Because Dad had the black bat.
Because the black bat was in the mud.
Because the red bat had a crack.
